import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { AnchoredController } from '../../controllers/anchored-controller.js';
export declare class Tooltip extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        text: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        relationship: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        triggerLabel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        triggerId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        textId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        placement: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        touchToggle: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        suppressed: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    text: string;
    relationship: string;
    triggerLabel: string;
    triggerId: string;
    textId: string;
    placement: string;
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    touchToggle: boolean;
    private suppressed;
    private state;
    private fallbackBoundary?;
    private pendingEscape;
    private escapeOrigin;
    private closeTimer?;
    private hovered;
    private blurGeneration;
    private keyboardDeparture;
    private tabDeparturePending;
    private handleFocus;
    private handleBlur;
    readonly anchor: AnchoredController;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    private show;
    private leave;
    private key;
    private keyUp;
    private outside;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
